data.name: Pong 2P Court
data.notes: Two-player Pong vertical slice. Player 1: cursor up/down. Player 2: joystick 1 up/down. The control_2_players component drives both paddles in the SCREEN 4 ROM runtime.

properties.rule: Update vertical paddles, advance the ball, apply wall/paddle bounces, and keep gameplay active.
When the ball overlaps an effect value 3 cell, clear that item, add score, increment collectible count, and invert DY.
Paddle impact point selects one of six vertical ball angles.
